cues: Sexual reproduction happens in the flower.
The stamens form the androecium: each is a filament carrying an anther.
The anther is a microsporangium: it makes microspores, which become pollen.
text: Sexual reproduction happens in the flower. The stamens form the androecium: each is a filament carrying an anther. The anther is a microsporangium: it makes microspores, which become pollen.
